author: ojiudezue
title: Envoy stream add-on appears to drive peak battery cutouts; kept off
summary: Peak (16-21h) battery dropouts: 0-8/day before the stream add-on, 37-94/day with it on (09-25..28), 9 with it off (09-29). Add-on stopped (boot manual). Operator plan: second off night, then re-enable for one peak (A/B/A) to confirm. No external reports of this; ha-enphase-realtime runs the stream 24/7 without reporting it, so the cause may be our add-on's polling/session behaviour rather than the stream itself.
why: Single-house evidence, one off night — strong but not conclusive; hence the A/B/A before closing.
implications: ENVOY-STREAM-SOC-TIER-1 premise fails while the stream must stay off. pyenphase 4.0.5 (HA 2026.9.4) cut Envoy unavailability from ~100-150/day to 9-17/day; the remaining session-closed path waits on HA PR #183172.
revisit_trigger: Dropouts return with the add-on off (-> Enphase-side case) or stay low when re-enabled (-> stream exonerated).
